assertions.assertion: Uses JsonWebTokenHandler.ReadJsonWebToken (or JwtSecurityTokenHandler) to parse the access token string
Asserts the client_id claim matches the test client's ID
assertions.rationale: Asserts `jwt.GetClaim("client_id").Value` equals "test-client", the request's client id.

assertions.assertion: Asserts the scope claim contains the expected scope value
assertions.rationale: Splits the scope claim and asserts `Contains("api1", scope.Split(' '))`.

assertions.assertion: Asserts the issuer (iss) claim matches the expected authority URL
Does NOT make a network call to validate the token — parses it locally
assertions.rationale: Reads the token locally with ReadJsonWebToken; explicitly states no introspection/userinfo request is made.
